title: Keyword Arguments a DuckDBCSVRepeatingHeaderReader
description: Arguments to contol how the DuckDB CSV Header Reader interacts with a csv file

non_unique_header_error_code.description: Allows you to customise the error code generated in the error report when there are more than 1 set of values for a header.

non_unique_header_error_message.description: Allows you to customise the error message generated in the error report when there are more than 1 set of values for a header.
